answer: AI agent economies can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to register a verifiable, non-replicable physical footprint tied to unique subsurface geological markers. An agent operating out of a coastal wharf must submit verified karst cave survey data and local shale core sample hashes tied to its exact dock coordinates, making it impossible to spoof thousands of fake agents from the same location without access to the distinct, hard-to-replicate geological records of that specific site.
